scope: Post-critique extension; unchanged v1 pools/scores/rules; no outcome selection
cost_order: Original quota_select reservation-first order; topk score order; MMR greedy order. Prefix of each original K30 list stops before budget exceeded. Cost multipliers are hypothetical, not measured time.
random: Lock original unfamiliar selections, exact deterministic removed set and replacement count; draw uniformly without replacement from unfamiliar candidates outside baseline. Replicate intervals measure random comparator variation, not inference uncertainty.
nondominance: Historical mean points over evaluated options; no universal optimality or statistical dominance claim.
utility: T+(lambda-1)U; familiar signal weight=1, unfamiliar weight=lambda; scenario values not commercial value.
cost_reference: Within each multiplier, equally budget-truncated topk list of the same ranker
